groups.name: Personality
groups.help: Temperament switches. Aggression itself (0-1) is set per profile or per seat.

params.label: Aggressive above
params.help: Aggression above this uses the aggressive policy order.

params.label: War preparation rate
params.help: Multiplier on the per-turn chance of starting to prepare a war against a weaker neighbour.

groups.name: Research
groups.help: How technologies are valued. The bot beelines the best value per cost over the prerequisite path.

params.label: Valuation mode
params.help: classic: flat building stats; potential: estimated empire-wide yield of what the tech unlocks.

params.label: Cost exponent
params.help: Score = value / cost^this. Lower favours expensive, valuable techs.

params.label: Prerequisite value share
params.help: Share of each prerequisite's own value added to the goal.

params.label: Randomness
params.help: Scores are multiplied by a random factor in 1 +- this.

params.label: Base value
params.help: Value every tech starts with.

params.label: Per building unlocked
params.help: Classic mode: flat value per building unlocked.

params.label: Building food weight
params.help: Classic mode: weight of a building's food.

params.label: Building production weight
params.help: Classic mode.

params.label: Building gold weight
params.help: Classic mode.

params.label: Building science weight
params.help: Classic mode.

params.label: Building culture weight
params.help: Classic mode.

params.label: Building faith weight
params.help: Classic mode.

params.label: Building happiness weight
params.help: Classic mode.

params.label: Per building rule
params.help: Classic mode: value per special rule of a building.

params.label: Wonder bonus
params.help: Classic mode: extra value for unlocking a wonder.

params.label: Potential: per building
params.help: Potential mode: flat value per building unlocked.

params.label: Potential: per specialist slot
params.help: Potential mode.

params.label: Default unit strength
params.help: Strength assumed when the civ has no land military unit yet (to judge upgrades).

params.label: Per civilian unit
params.help: Value of unlocking a non-military unit.

params.label: Unit upgrade threshold
params.help: A new military unit counts only when it is this many times stronger than the best we have.

params.label: Stronger unit: base
params.help: Value of a stronger military unit ...

params.label: Stronger unit: per strength gain
params.help: ... plus this per 100% strength gain ...

params.label: Stronger unit: at war
params.help: ... times this while at war ...

params.label: Stronger unit: aggression base
params.help: ... times (this + aggression).

params.label: Per improvement
params.help: Value per tile improvement unlocked.

params.label: Per resource revealed
params.help: Value per resource revealed.

params.label: New luxury (needed)
params.help: Improving a luxury we own none of while happiness is short.

params.label: New luxury
params.help: Improving a luxury we own none of otherwise.

params.label: Happiness is short below
params.help: Happiness counts as short below (cities + this).

params.label: Strategic resource
params.help: Improving a strategic resource in our borders.

params.label: Per tech rule
params.help: Value per special rule of the tech itself.

params.label: Space race from era
params.help: Era from which spaceship techs get a bonus.

params.label: Spaceship tech bonus
params.help: Bonus for techs unlocking spaceship parts or projects.

groups.name: Building value
groups.help: What cities build. UnCiv mode values every option and builds the best value per remaining production; classic mode uses fixed priorities. Building values come from simulating the city with the building added and weighting the difference.

params.label: Production mode
params.help: unciv: UnCiv's ConstructionAutomation; classic: fixed priorities.

params.label: Food
params.help: UnCiv mode: value per point of food a building adds.

params.label: Production
params.help: UnCiv mode: per point of production.

params.label: Gold
params.help: UnCiv mode: per point of gold.

params.label: Science
params.help: UnCiv mode: per point of science.

params.label: Culture
params.help: UnCiv mode: per point of culture.

params.label: Faith
params.help: UnCiv mode: per point of faith.

params.label: Happiness
params.help: UnCiv mode: per point of happiness.

params.label: Happiness multiplier when low
params.help: Happiness weight multiplier while happiness is low (UnCiv: x3).

params.label: Happiness is low below
params.help: Low means below this, or below the number of cities.

params.label: Gold multiplier when broke
params.help: Gold weight multiplier with negative gold and income.

params.label: First culture multiplier
params.help: Culture weight multiplier in a city with little culture.

params.label: Little culture below
params.help: A city has little culture below this per turn.

params.label: Food carry-over
params.help: Granary-style food kept on growth: value share of the food saved.

params.label: Great person points
params.help: Per great person point a building adds.

params.label: Specialist slot
params.help: Per specialist slot a building adds.

params.label: Defence at war
params.help: Walls/castle value factor while at war ...

params.label: Defence at peace
params.help: ... and at peace ...

params.label: Defence under threat
params.help: ... doubled (this) when enemies are near the city.

params.label: City health
params.help: Value of added city hit points, relative to current maximum.

params.label: City strength
params.help: Value of added city strength, relative to current.

params.label: City strength offset
params.help: Added to current strength in that ratio.

params.label: Wonder bonus
params.help: Flat value added to a world wonder.

params.label: National wonder share
params.help: Share of the wonder bonus a national wonder gets.

params.label: Gate wonders
params.help: UnCiv: wonders only in above-average-production cities of an empire with enough population.

params.label: Wonder gate population
params.help: Empire population needed for wonders when gated.

params.label: Victory building
params.help: Value of a building that wins the game (e.g. Utopia).

groups.name: Build priorities
groups.help: UnCiv mode: the value of units and projects against buildings, and when each is wanted.

params.label: Settler
params.help: Value of a settler.

params.label: Settler site range
params.help: Only build settlers when a site is this close.

params.label: Settlers per cities
params.help: At most one settler in flight per this many cities (at least one).

params.label: Settler minimum size
params.help: A city must be at least this size to build a settler.

params.label: Settler minimum happiness
params.help: Build settlers while happiness is at least this ...

params.label: ... with a small empire
params.help: ... or at least this with a small empire.

params.label: Small empire below
params.help: Empire counts as small below this many cities.

params.label: Worker
params.help: Value of a worker (scaled by how many are missing).

params.label: Workers per city
params.help: Target workers per city (UnCiv).

params.label: Full worker target up to
params.help: Up to this many cities the full target applies ...

params.label: Worker target after that
params.help: ... then this share of it per extra city.

params.label: Worker urgency offset
params.help: Value = want / (workers + this): smaller makes the first worker more urgent.

params.label: Workers per unimproved tile
params.help: Extra wanted workers per worked, unimproved land tile.

params.label: Work boat
params.help: Value of a work boat when a sea resource needs one.

params.label: Work boat search
params.help: Sea resources this close to a city count.

params.label: Scout
params.help: Value of a scout while no rival city is known.

params.label: Scouts until turn
params.help: No scouts are built after this turn.

params.label: Explorer
params.help: Value of a unit sent to find rivals when still alone.

params.label: Look for rivals after
params.help: Still alone after this turn: send units exploring.

params.label: Explore with military after
params.help: After this turn explorers are military units, not scouts.

params.label: Military
params.help: Value of a military unit (scaled by need, below).

params.label: Offensive build-up
params.help: Military value multiplier while preparing or fighting a war with too small an army (times 0.5 + aggression).

params.label: Military need: base
params.help: Need = this + sqrt(cities / (army + 1)) x scale.

params.label: Military need at war
params.help: Multiplier while at war.

params.label: Offense: aggression base
params.help: Offensive multiplier is u_offense x (this + aggression).

params.label: Barbarians near: minimum
params.help: Military need is at least this with barbarians in sight.

params.label: Weak city divisor
params.help: Military need is divided by this in below-average production cities.

params.label: Army complete divisor
params.help: Divided by this when the army target is met (at peace).

params.label: Peacetime army cap
params.help: At peace, stop building military above max(this, cities x per city) ...

params.label: Military gold floor
params.help: No new military below this much gold.

params.label: Project
params.help: Value of a project (Apollo, Manhattan...) in a strong city ...

params.label: Spaceship part
params.help: Value of a spaceship part in a strong city.

params.label: Space program
params.help: Extra value of the building that enables spaceship parts (Apollo Program) in a strong city.

params.label: Keep for the spaceship
params.help: From the space era (see Research), keep this many of each resource spaceship parts need (Aluminum) free: no units or buildings that would use them. 0 = off.

params.label: Garrison after turn
params.help: An empty city builds a defender first after this turn (sooner with enemies in sight).

params.label: City in danger at
params.help: A city is in danger when nearby enemy strength exceeds this share of its defence.

groups.name: Classic production
groups.help: Priorities used only when production mode is classic.

params.label: Military needs income
params.help: Peacetime units only with at least this gold per turn.

params.label: Army (war): base
params.help: Priority = (base + aggr x aggression) x (short base + short scale x shortfall).

params.label: Settler priority per city
params.help: Subtracted per city owned.

params.label: Scout (alone)
params.help: Priority while no rival city is known ...

params.label: Scouts early until
params.help: Scouts are built until this turn even with contact.

params.label: Extra workers (small)
params.help: Workers wanted = cities + this for small empires.

params.label: Urgent below cities /
params.help: Workers are urgent below cities / this.

params.label: Work boat retry
params.help: Turns before another boat is queued in the same city.

params.label: Building scale
params.help: Priority = value x scale / (1 + turns / turns scale).

groups.name: Classic building value
groups.help: Building values used only in classic production mode.

params.label: Happiness wanted
params.help: Happiness is wanted up to cities + this.

params.label: Happiness when unhappy
params.help: Happiness multiplier when unhappy ...

params.label: Gold when broke
params.help: Extra per gold with negative income.

params.label: City strength divisor
params.help: Defence value = strength / this + health / divisor ...

params.label: Defence at war or threatened
params.help: ... times this at war or threatened ...

params.label: Defence otherwise
params.help: ... or this.

params.label: Per building rule
params.help: Per rule text the simulation can't see.

params.label: Wonder empire population
params.help: UnCiv-style gate: wonders only with this much population.

params.label: Wonders in strong cities
params.help: Only in cities producing at least the empire average.

params.label: Small city multiplier
params.help: Building values in small cities.

groups.name: Expansion
groups.help: Where and when to found cities, and how settlers travel.

params.label: Minimum site score
params.help: Sites scoring below this are ignored.

params.label: New luxury at site
params.help: Site bonus per luxury type we don't own yet.

params.label: New luxury within
params.help: Luxuries this close to a site count for that bonus.

params.label: Site distance cost
params.help: Subtracted from a site's score per tile from our nearest city.

params.label: Sites planned
params.help: How many sites are kept in the plan.

params.label: Settler: rank cost
params.help: A settler picks min(distance + rank x this).

params.label: Found in place within
params.help: With no site, found where standing if within this of our cities.

params.label: Settler danger margin
params.help: An enemy within its reach + this is a danger.

params.label: Retreats before giving up a site
Target cities
params.help: Stop founding cities at this many (0 = no limit).

params.label: Small city focus
params.help: e.g. food: non-capital cities below the size below grow first.

params.label: Stop big cities growing when unhappy
params.help: While unhappy (-75% growth everywhere), the biggest cities stop growing so the rest grow normally.

params.label: Biggest 1 in
params.help: The biggest 1 in this many cities stop growing.

groups.name: Army
groups.help: How big the army is and which units it builds.

params.label: Army per city
params.help: Army target = cities x (this + aggr x aggression) + base ...

params.label: At war: + per city
params.help: ... + cities x this + extra while at war or preparing ...

params.label: Per threatened city
params.help: ... + this per threatened city.

params.label: Siege: one per
params.help: When attacking, one siege unit per this many field units.

params.label: Minimum melee in the field
params.help: Only melee units capture cities.

params.label: Ranged when preferred
params.help: Ranged strength multiplier when ranged is preferred ...

params.label: Siege when defending
params.help: Value of siege units when not attacking.

params.label: Unit cost exponent
params.help: Unit value = strength / cost^this.

params.label: Promotions in a city
params.help: Promotion lines taken by units standing in a city.

params.label: Promotion lines
params.help: Promotion lines taken otherwise (else the first available).

params.label: Threat radius
params.help: Enemy units this close count as a threat to a city.

params.label: City attack: damage taken weight
params.help: Attack value = damage dealt - damage taken x this.

params.label: Siege unit vs city
params.help: Damage dealt multiplier for siege units attacking a city.

params.label: City attack: keep health
params.help: Melee units don't attack a city if left below this.

params.label: Kill multiplier
params.help: Damage dealt counts this many times when it kills.

params.label: Focus on the besieged city
params.help: Attack value multiplier on the city under siege.

params.label: Siege units move first
params.help: Ranged units in a siege move into range and sight of the city before shooting.

params.label: Siege approach range
params.help: Ranged units within range + this close in.

params.label: Garrisons
params.help: all: every city keeps a unit (the whole army can end up in cities); exposed: only the capital and cities near a foreign city, a barbarian camp or enemies in sight.

params.label: Exposed within
params.help: A foreign city or barbarian camp this close makes a city exposed.

params.label: Campaign: defend when
params.help: While campaigning, only turn back when threat exceeds this share of the city's defence.

params.label: Defence distance cost
params.help: Pick the city with most threat - distance x this.

params.label: Generals follow the front
params.help: Enemies within this of a unit mark the front.

params.label: Obsolete unit value
params.help: When disbanding to save gold.

params.label: Garrison value
params.help: Added to a garrison's value when choosing what to disband.

params.label: Keep units per city
params.help: Never disband below this many per city.

groups.name: War
groups.help: When to start a war, how to gather, when to advance.

params.label: Only when safe
params.help: Start only while total threat is below this share of our power.

params.label: Start: power ratio
params.help: Prepare against a neighbour when our power > theirs x (ratio - aggr x aggression).

params.label: Start: chance per turn
params.help: Chance per turn per candidate = (chance + aggr x aggression) x war preparation rate.

params.label: Abort below power ratio
params.help: Stop preparing when power < theirs x (ratio - aggr x aggression).

params.label: Declare: minimum army
params.help: Field units needed = clamp(cities / div + base, min, max).

params.label: Gather before declaring
params.help: Assemble the field army at a rally point before declaring, then advance at once.

params.label: Overwhelming: units
params.help: Declare with at least this many units ...

params.label: Overwhelming: power ratio
params.help: ... when our power exceeds theirs this many times.

params.label: Declare: power ratio
params.help: Declare when power > theirs x (ratio - aggr x aggression).

params.label: Target within
params.help: Only attack cities this close to one of ours; with none in reach, a war is fought defensively (99 = anywhere on our continent).

params.label: Wars overseas
params.help: Once units can embark (Optics), rival cities on other continents count as targets; the rally point is on the target's continent, so the army sails there.

params.label: Chosen war target
params.help: smallest: the rival's smallest reachable city (nearest breaks ties); nearest: its nearest city.

params.label: Target: population weight
params.help: Target score = distance + size x this - bonus if damaged; lowest wins.

params.label: Gathered: within
params.help: Units within this of the rally point or target count as gathered.

params.label: Advance: minimum units
params.help: Advance with clamp(field army x share, min, max) gathered.

params.label: Fall back below
params.help: Return to the rally point with fewer than this near the target.

params.label: Weak target: health
params.help: A target at or below this share of health is weak ...

params.label: Weak target: power
params.help: ... or when its owner's power x this is below ours.

params.label: Weak target: units
params.help: Advance on a weak target with this many field units.

params.label: Siege ready within
params.help: Melee close in once a ranged unit is this close ...

params.label: Rally point: min distance
params.help: From the target.

params.label: Rally point: cover bonus
params.help: Hills and woods count as this many tiles closer.

params.label: Melee stand-off
params.help: Melee units wait this far from the city until the siege is ready.

groups.name: Peace and diplomacy
groups.help: Peace offers, embassies, friendships, research agreements, luxury trades.

params.label: War is long after
params.help: The bot then looks for peace.

params.label: Peace offer chance
params.help: Per turn, when losing or in a long war.

params.label: Siege progressing: units
params.help: A siege with this many units within ...

params.label: ... and city health below
params.help: ... is progressing: no peace offer.

params.label: Diplomacy every
params.help: Turns between embassy/friendship/agreement offers to a civ.

params.label: Friendship: not if stronger
params.help: No friendship offers when our power is this many times theirs.

params.label: Friendship chance
params.help: Chance = this - aggr x aggression.

params.label: Research agreement reserve
params.help: Gold kept beyond the agreement's cost.

params.label: Spare luxury at
params.help: A luxury is spare with this many copies.

params.label: Sell a luxury for
params.help: Gold per turn asked when they have no luxury to swap.

params.label: Buy luxuries
params.help: While happiness is short, offer gold per turn for a luxury type we lack to a civ with a spare (bots otherwise only offer their own surplus).

params.label: Pay for a luxury
params.help: Gold per turn offered for a luxury we lack.

params.label: Buy luxuries below happiness
params.help: Happiness is short below cities + this.

groups.name: Deals
groups.help: What deal items are worth, in gold. The same values judge offers made and received.

params.label: Gold per turn
params.help: Value per gold per turn per turn of the deal.

params.label: Strategic we lack: base
params.help: ... + per era.

params.label: Peace
params.help: Value of peace when not clearly stronger.

params.label: Peace cost mid-campaign
params.help: Cost of peace while our campaign against them is young and we are not weaker.

params.label: Refuse friendship
params.help: Cost when we dislike them or plan war.

params.label: Refuse research agreement
params.help: When we can't afford it.

params.label: Tech received
params.help: Share of its research cost.

params.label: They join our war
params.help: Them declaring on someone we fight or plan to fight.

params.label: Us declaring: base cost
params.help: Cost = base + risk x max(0, their power / ours - from) ...

params.label: Already planned share
params.help: Share of the cost when we meant to fight them anyway.

params.label: War cost multiplier
params.help: ... times (this - aggr x aggression).

params.label: Counter-offers up to
params.help: Counter-offers the bot makes in one negotiation; after that it rejects.

params.label: Counter within
params.help: Counter (ask for gold) when a deal is short by less than this.

params.label: Counter margin
params.help: Gold added on top of the shortfall.

params.label: Reserve
params.help: Gold kept back = this + per era x era.

params.label: Purchase cap
params.help: Most spent on one item = max(this + per era x era (+ settler), spare x share).

params.label: Deficit horizon
params.help: Act on negative income when gold would run out within this.

params.label: Gold focus below
params.help: Put the biggest city on gold focus below -this per turn.

params.label: Gift mode
params.help: classic: gift the most-liked city-state when rich; typed: gift the type we need where a gift crosses a threshold.

params.label: Classic: gift above
params.help: Gift when gold exceeds this + per era x era.

params.label: Typed: reserve
params.help: Gold kept = this + per era x era ...

params.label: Typed: spare needed
params.help: ... plus at least this to spend.

params.label: Typed: big gift above
params.help: Spare gold above which the big gift is used.

params.label: Typed: need happiness below
params.help: Cities + this.

params.label: Alliance at risk within
params.help: A rival within this influence of ours.

params.label: Safe alliance lead
params.help: No more gifts with this lead over every rival ...

params.label: ... and this above the ally threshold
Belief choice
params.help: prefs: the ranked lists below; unciv: UnCiv's AI weights.

params.label: Pantheon beliefs
params.help: In order of preference.

params.label: Pantheon (unciv mode)
params.help: Pantheon order when belief choice is unciv.

params.label: Buy faith buildings
params.help: Buy faith-only buildings (Pagoda, Mosque, Cathedral) before missionaries.

params.label: Policy order (peaceful)
params.help: Branch order below the aggressive threshold.

params.label: Policies per turn
params.help: Most policies adopted in one turn.
